benefits.detail: Up to $300 in statement credits January-June and another $300 July-December on eligible prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts, The Hotel Collection (2+ nights) or Airbnb Luxe stays of 2+ nights booked through American Express Travel. From January 1, 2027, Fine Hotels + Resorts bookings also need 2+ nights for the credit. Lodging credit is shared across eligible booking types, not separate hotel and Airbnb allowances.

benefits.title: Airbnb Experiences credit
benefits.detail: Up to US$250 per calendar year on eligible Experiences bought directly with Airbnb, only after an eligible prepaid Airbnb Luxe booking through Amex Travel unlocks the benefit. Link eligible Amex and Airbnb accounts. Qualifying Experience payment must occur during the remaining unlocked calendar-year period; third-party checkout excluded. Verify unlocked status before purchase. No separate credit for every Luxe booking.

benefits.title: Uber Cash
benefits.detail: Add eligible card to Uber account: US$15 Uber Cash/month plus US$20 extra in December (US$200/year); use an Amex card for eligible US rides/orders. Monthly cash expires and is not an unrestricted statement credit.

benefits.title: Uber One credit
benefits.detail: Up to US$120/calendar year on eligible auto-renewing Uber One membership charged to the card; monthly/annual plan and account terms apply.

benefits.title: Digital entertainment credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$25/calendar month for eligible direct subscriptions at Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, The New York Times, Peacock, The Wall Street Journal, Paramount+ and YouTube Premium/YouTube TV; third-party bundles/payment exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Airline fee credit
benefits.detail: Up to $200 per calendar year for eligible incidental fees charged by one selected qualifying airline.

benefits.title: lululemon credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$75/calendar quarter on eligible US lululemon retail stores (excluding outlets) and lululemon.com purchases; gift cards and excluded channels do not qualify.

benefits.title: CLEAR+ credit
benefits.detail: Up to $219 per calendar year toward an eligible CLEAR+ membership.

benefits.title: Oura Ring credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$200/calendar year for eligible Oura Ring purchases directly at ouraring.com; not a reimbursement for every Oura subscription or third-party purchase.

benefits.title: Walmart+ credit
benefits.detail: Pay for one auto-renewing monthly Walmart+ membership: up to US$12.95/month plus applicable tax; annual plans and Plus Up excluded.

benefits.title: Equinox credit
benefits.detail: Enroll: up to US$300/calendar year on eligible direct Equinox club membership or Equinox+ subscription payments. Membership/eligible-service restrictions apply; not a general fitness credit.

benefits.title: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.detail: Charge eligible application fee: Global Entry US$120 or TSA PreCheck up to US$85 through an official provider, once every four years under current issuer product terms. Not both credits in the same four-year period; application approval is independent. Manual one-time tracker must be reset only at your actual next eligibility date.

benefits.title: Venue concessions — 10% back, up to $250
benefits.detail: Enroll one eligible US-issued Consumer/Business Amex per person: 10% back on qualifying food/beverage concessions at participating Amex Venue Collection venues, capped at US$250/calendar year through December 31, 2026. Full cap requires US$2,500 of qualifying spend. One shared enrollment per person, not a separate allowance for every card; excluded venues, merchants, purchase types and payment channels apply.

benefits.title: Priority Pass Select
benefits.detail: Enroll eligible Platinum card for participating airport-lounge access; up to two accompanying guests complimentary where permitted. Restaurants and other non-lounge experiences are excluded; network capacity and local guest rules apply. Companion cards do not receive this membership.

benefits.title: Hilton Honors Gold
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Hilton Honors Gold status.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status.

benefits.title: Leading Hotels of the World Sterling
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Leaders Club Sterling status under current Platinum terms.

benefits.title: Avis Preferred
benefits.detail: Enrollment for eligible Avis Preferred benefits.

benefits.title: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards
benefits.detail: Enrollment for eligible Hertz elite benefits under current Platinum terms.

benefits.title: National Emerald Club
benefits.detail: Enrollment for eligible National Emerald Club Executive benefits.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.detail: Global Lounge Collection: network-specific itineraries, guests, enrollment and capacity rules apply. Priority Pass Select requires enrollment; Delta Sky Club has a separate annual visit allotment; Centurion/Sidecar have separate entry/guest restrictions. Companion cards are not equivalent to paid Additional Platinum cards.

benefits.title: Centurion & Sidecar lounges
benefits.detail: Eligible Platinum, matching confirmed same-day boarding pass and ID; Centurion entry within three hours of departure, connecting entry within five hours, no arrival-only access. Sidecar entry within 90 minutes. US Platinum guests generally US$50/adult and US$30/age 2–17 at US locations; under 2 free. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks up to two complimentary guests through January 31 after the following year. Location fees differ; guests must share the flight; capacity terms apply.

benefits.title: Delta Sky Club — 10 annual visits
benefits.detail: US eligible basic/paid Additional Platinum: 10 visits each February 1–January 31, each covering eligible entries within 24 hours. Same-day Delta-operated flight or Delta-marketed WestJet (006 ticket); Main Basic/equivalent excluded. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks unlimited visits through January 31 of the year after the following year. After allotment, US$50/visit; guests US$50/person, eligible itinerary required. Three-hour departure rule; issuer/Delta layover timing differs—verify before a long connection.

benefits.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
benefits.detail: Eligible FHR bookings receive program benefits such as daily breakfast for two, property amenity, room upgrade when available and late checkout under current terms. From January 1, 2027, the statement credit needs a stay of 2 nights or more; the perks still apply on one-night stays.

benefits.title: The Hotel Collection
benefits.detail: Qualifying stays through The Hotel Collection receive current program benefits; minimum stay requirements apply.

benefits.title: Platinum Concierge
benefits.detail: Access to Platinum Concierge service for eligible requests.

benefits.title: Global Dining Access
benefits.detail: Access to eligible dining inventory and experiences through current Platinum dining programs.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences / ticket access
benefits.detail: Access to eligible presales, reserved tickets and cardmember experiences where offered.

benefits.title: Amex Offers
benefits.detail: Eligible targeted statement-credit or points offers may be available after enrollment; offers vary by account.

benefits.title: Premium Global Assist Hotline
benefits.detail: 24-hour emergency assistance when travelling more than 100 miles from home. Certain approved emergency medical evacuation/transport services may be arranged without charge under Premium Global Assist terms. Third-party service costs generally remain yours unless expressly covered; contact Amex for advance approval. This is not general emergency medical insurance.

benefits.title: Cruise Privileges Program
benefits.detail: Eligible cruise bookings through participating Amex Travel services can receive specified shipboard credits/amenities; cruise line, itinerary, cabin and booking rules apply. This is booking access, not an elite status grant.

benefits.title: Unlock unlimited Delta Sky Club visits
benefits.detail: US$75,000 eligible calendar-year card-account spend unlocks unlimited eligible Delta Sky Club visits for the rest of the current Medallion Year and the following Medallion Year; itinerary, ticket and guest rules remain. This is lounge access, not airline elite status.

benefits.title: Unlock complimentary Centurion guests
benefits.detail: US$75,000 eligible calendar-year account spend unlocks up to two complimentary guests per eligible Centurion visit, through January 31 of the year after the following year. Same-flight, age, location, Sidecar and capacity rules remain.

benefits.title: Invest with Rewards
benefits.detail: Eligible cardmembers may redeem Membership Rewards for deposits into an eligible Schwab brokerage/retirement account. Current conversion tiers/annual limits require the issuer redemption terms, which were not publicly readable during this review; no unverified conversion value is used for Best Card.

benefits.title: Conditional Schwab Appreciation Bonus
benefits.detail: Annual card statement credit based on qualifying Schwab holdings: US$100 at US$250,000 to below US$1 million; US$200 at US$1 million to below US$10 million; US$1,000 at US$10 million or more. Holding measurement, eligible accounts, timing and exclusions apply; not an automatic credit for every cardmember.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation & interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Covered round-trip cancellation/interruption: up to US$10,000/trip and US$20,000/card/12 months for each coverage, excess of other benefits. Full common-carrier transport paid with card/allowed points or vouchers; only defined causes qualify, not any reason. Pre-existing conditions and supplier insolvency excluded. Notify insurer and supplier within required times; insurer notice 60 days, proof 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered round trip delayed more than 6 hours: up to US$500/trip, two claims/card/12 months, excess of other benefits. Pay full common-carrier transport with the card/allowed points or vouchers and additional expenses with that card. Weather, equipment failure, hijacking/terrorism or lost travel documents may qualify; known delays excluded. Notify within 60 days; proof within 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.detail: Prior month's eligible wireless bill paid with card: covered theft/damage including cracked screens, up to US$800/claim after US$50 deductible, two claims/account/12 months; excess of other insurance. Lost/mysteriously disappeared phones and cosmetic damage excluded. Theft police report within 48 hours; notify claim within 90 days/as soon as reasonably possible, written proof within 120 days.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible card-paid new purchases: 90 days against theft/accidental damage/loss; up to US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Natural-disaster sublimit US$500/event. Only eligible card payment is covered; item/event exclusions apply. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Extends eligible original manufacturer warranties of five years or less by up to one year, after the original warranty/service contract. Warranty must be valid in the US/DC/territories; up to eligible card payment, US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Exclusions apply; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible and normally submit proof within 60 days.

benefits.title: Return protection
benefits.detail: Eligible items paid entirely with the card in the US/covered territories: if the seller refuses a return within 90 days, up to US$300/item and US$1,000/account/calendar year, excluding original shipping. Item must be unused, undamaged and working; exclusions include jewellery, software and consumables. Notify within 90 days of purchase; requested documents and returned item normally within 30 days of the respective request.

benefits.title: Car rental loss & damage insurance
benefits.detail: Secondary theft/damage cover up to US$75,000/rental agreement, first 30 consecutive days. Reserve/pay the entire rental with the eligible card and decline CDW/similar cover. Australia, Italy, New Zealand, peer-to-peer rentals and excluded vehicles are not covered; no liability insurance. State provisions vary; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible, proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered loss/theft/damage: carry-on up to US$3,000, checked US$2,000, high-risk items US$1,000; combined US$3,000/person/trip. NY US$2,000/bag and US$10,000/trip aggregate. Full common-carrier fare paid with card/eligible Amex rewards; other-program redemptions excluded. Excess of other cover; eligible family covered. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Rental-car accident protection
benefits.detail: Eligible covered rental accidents: scheduled accidental death/dismemberment up to US$200,000/Cardmember or US$20,000/other eligible driver/passenger; accidental-injury treatment up to US$5,000/person. Shared US$300,000/accident aggregate. Only for eligible card-paid rentals, not general travel medical insurance. State provisions, authorization, timing and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Rental-car personal property
benefits.detail: Eligible personal-property theft/damage during a covered rental: up to US$1,000/eligible person and US$2,000/rental accident aggregate. Full eligible rental payment and driver/rental conditions required. Excess coverage, exclusions and state-specific provisions apply.

benefits.title: Indeed credit
benefits.detail: Up to C$75 each calendar quarter on eligible Indeed purchases under current terms.

benefits.title: Wireless credit
benefits.detail: Register once and spend at least C$10/month on eligible direct Canadian national mobile service charges to receive C$10/month, up to C$120 in a 12-month period. Supplementary cards, reseller/third-party and excluded bundled services do not qualify. Public terms state no fixed end date.

benefits.title: Dell credit
benefits.detail: Up to C$100 January-June and C$100 July-December on eligible Dell purchases under current terms.

benefits.title: Instacart credits
benefits.detail: After registration: two separate eligible C$10+ Instacart Canada transactions can each earn C$10 per month (C$20 maximum), through December 31, 2027. Same enrolled basic card, CAD purchases shipped within Canada; excluded goods/services and timing rules apply.

benefits.title: QuickBooks credit
benefits.detail: One-time up to C$100 on eligible Canadian QuickBooks subscription purchases at quickbooks.ca/amex, charged to the registered basic card by February 28, 2027. Canadian CAD purchase; excluded products and third-party/reseller purchases do not qualify. Subscription auto-renews; supplementary purchases ineligible.

benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Hilton Honors Gold status.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite
benefits.detail: Enrollment benefit for Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status.

benefits.title: Hertz Five Star rental privileges
benefits.detail: Enroll for Hertz Five Star; one-class upgrade subject to availability, additional-driver waiver and qualifying rental discounts under partner terms.

benefits.title: Avis rental privileges
benefits.detail: Qualifying rentals with published AWD code may receive location-dependent discounts; taxes/extras excluded. Avis Preferred membership is an entry membership, not a higher earned elite tier.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.detail: Global Lounge Collection access subject to network, itinerary and guest rules; Priority Pass enrollment required. Through 2026, eligible Platinum cards have unlimited participating Priority Pass/Plaza Premium access. From January 1, 2027: basic card six visits/year to EACH network, eligible supplementary Platinum two/year to EACH; accompanying guests consume visits. C$20,000 eligible calendar-year account spend unlocks unlimited access for the rest of that year and the following year (2026 spend counts for 2027). Other network terms remain separate.

benefits.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
benefits.detail: Book 1,600+ hotels through Amex Travel or Platinum Card Travel Service for noon check-in, a room upgrade when available, daily breakfast for two (at least US$60 a room a day), guaranteed 4 p.m. late checkout, Wi-Fi and a property benefit; up to three rooms a stay.

benefits.title: The Hotel Collection
benefits.detail: Stays of 2+ nights at 700+ hotels booked through Amex Travel: a US$100 hotel credit for dining, spa or other room charges, a room upgrade when available, noon check-in and late checkout when available.

benefits.title: Hotel Status Benefit
benefits.detail: Enrol for Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite and Hilton Honors Gold status. Your hotel program name and email must match your Amex account.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences
benefits.detail: Front Of The Line presale and reserved tickets for concerts, theatre and events, plus cardmember perks at events, in the Amex Experiences app.

benefits.title: Front Of The Line presale and reserved tickets
benefits.detail: Buy tickets to in-demand concerts, theatre and events before the general public, or from seats held for Amex cardmembers. Tickets must be charged to an Amex card.

benefits.title: Amex Offers
benefits.detail: Targeted statement-credit and bonus-point offers at selected merchants. Add an offer in the Amex app or online before you pay with the card.

benefits.title: Platinum Concierge
benefits.detail: 24/7 help with restaurant reservations, event tickets, travel plans and hard-to-find items: call 1-888-721-1044, then press 3. You pay for anything bought for you.

benefits.title: International Airline Program — confirm eligibility
benefits.detail: Historical Canadian Business Platinum airline-savings entry retained under its existing ID. Current Canadian card eligibility, participating airlines, cabin/fare and booking terms were not confirmed from a public issuer page during this review; verify with Platinum Travel before relying on a discount.

benefits.title: Travel emergency assistance
benefits.detail: 24-hour assistance and referrals under the card terms. Third-party costs are generally the cardmember’s responsibility unless a separate insurance benefit applies; this service is not an additional medical insurance policy.

benefits.title: Unlock unlimited Priority Pass & Plaza Premium visits
benefits.detail: From January 1, 2027, C$20,000 in eligible calendar-year account spend restores unlimited participating Priority Pass and Plaza Premium access for the remainder of that year and the next. 2026 spend qualifies for 2027. Guest, supplementary-card, enrollment and network conditions apply.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences app
benefits.detail: Explore eligible cardmember events, ticket access and venue experiences in the American Express Experiences app. Inventory, event, venue, enrollment and payment terms apply; admission and purchases are generally separately charged.

benefits.title: Basic-card business offer conditions
benefits.detail: Register the eligible basic card and use that same card for qualifying purchases. Supplementary and third-party purchases may be excluded. Replacing or switching the card may require re-enrollment; check the saved offer terms.

benefits.title: Business credit enrollment & annual totals
benefits.detail: Registered Business Platinum offers include up to C$200 Dell, C$300 Indeed and C$120 wireless annually, plus separate Instacart and limited-time QuickBooks offers. Each has its own spend, expiry and basic-card terms; these totals are not another credit allowance. Use individual trackers.

benefits.title: Emergency medical insurance
benefits.detail: Up to C$5 million/person/trip outside the home province for the first 15 consecutive days, age 64 or under at departure. Canadian residency and government health plan required; eligible cardmember, spouse and dependants may travel separately. Generally 90-day medical stability; exclusions apply. Call Global Excel before treatment; otherwise a 20% share applies to the first C$25,000 of eligible expenses not recovered from the government plan.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation insurance
benefits.detail: Covered cancellation reasons only: C$1,500/person and C$3,000/all insured persons/trip. Any portion of eligible prepaid arrangements must be card-paid before cancellation penalties, or eligible Membership Rewards redemption with taxes paid as required. Generally 90-day pre-existing medical stability; other reward redemptions excluded. Notify insurer promptly; claim within 90 days of return; exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Trip interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Covered interruption: C$1,500/person, C$6,000/all insured persons/trip. Covered interruption/delay out-of-pocket costs C$100/day/person, C$1,000 combined. Eligible card/Membership Rewards prepaid arrangements required; generally 90-day pre-existing medical stability and defined causes. Notify insurer promptly; claim within 90 days of return; exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Flight delay insurance
benefits.detail: Full airline fare charged to card: covered departure delay/denied boarding or missed connection with no alternative transport within four hours. Reasonable eligible living expenses/sundry items share C$1,000/occurrence with emergency baggage delay; not separate allowances. Receipts, exclusions and reporting requirements apply.

benefits.title: Baggage delay & lost baggage insurance
benefits.detail: Baggage delay: six hours at outbound destination; eligible essentials within four days and before baggage return, shared C$1,000/occurrence with flight delay/missed connection. No homeward delay cover. Lost/stolen baggage: separate C$1,000/occurrence for all insured persons combined, with jewellery C$300/golf C$250 sublimits. Full eligible fare card-paid, carrier/other insurance and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Hotel/motel burglary insurance
benefits.detail: Covered accommodation reserved and fully charged to card: personal items lost/damaged in burglary up to C$1,000/occurrence. Proof of burglary, timely reporting, exclusions and other-insurance provisions apply.

benefits.title: Rental car collision/loss damage insurance
benefits.detail: Eligible rental theft/damage, not liability insurance. Entire rental card-paid or permitted Membership Rewards redemption; decline CDW where allowed. Original model-year MSRP not over C$85,000 before tax; maximum 48 consecutive days. Exceeding 48 days voids cover from day one. Eligible driver/vehicle, other-insurance and territorial terms apply; report loss/theft/damage within 48 hours.

benefits.title: Travel accident insurance
benefits.detail: Scheduled common-carrier accidental death/dismemberment benefits up to C$500,000/covered person. Entire eligible passenger fare must be card-paid; not general medical insurance. Covered loss must occur within 100 days of injury; loss schedule, exclusions and maximum indemnity apply.

benefits.title: Mobile device insurance
benefits.detail: Eligible mobile device bought/financed with card: theft/loss/accidental damage for up to two years, maximum C$1,500/occurrence/person, 2% monthly depreciation and 10% deductible. Timing depends on purchase/financing and event; outright-purchase theft/damage generally begins day 91 after purchase protection. Suspend wireless service within 48 hours of loss; theft police report within seven days. Exclusions and documentation apply.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible item partly or fully card-paid: theft/direct physical damage for 90 days, up to C$1,000/cardmember/occurrence including all affected items and limited to the card-paid portion. Excess of other cover; loss/mysterious disappearance excluded. Report within 48 hours; written notice preferably within 45 days and documentation within 90 days.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Full eligible purchase charged to card: extends eligible manufacturer warranty by its duration, up to one additional year, on original warranties of five years or less valid in Canada or the US. C$10,000/item and C$25,000/cardmember/policy year; excess of other insurance. Exclusions and documentation requirements apply.

benefits.title: Employee card misuse protection
benefits.detail: Issuer advertises up to C$100,000/cardmember for eligible supplementary employee misuse, subject to terms and cancellation within two business days after termination. Complete separate misuse policy, reporting deadlines, exclusions and recovery conditions were not publicly available; confirm with Amex before relying on this protection.

cards.feeNote: Current annual fee C$120; supplementary C$50 or no-fee limited-benefit card. From January 12, 2027 annual fee billing: basic C$150, supplementary C$59, renamed Companion Card C$25. Foreign currency surcharge 2.5%.
cards.coverageNote: Current product benefits, September 2026 agreement, July 1, 2025 insurance and official January 2027 change terms reviewed November 4, 2026. New 2027 benefits are dated separately. Card and Aeroplan account must be eligible/in good standing; link the correct Aeroplan account and include it on bookings. Status qualification credits do not grant automatic Aeroplan Elite status. Insurance payment, Canadian-residency, exclusions and claim evidence requirements apply.

benefits.title: 15% off eligible Air Canada flight rewards
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: 15% fewer points on the base fare of eligible Air Canada flight rewards, compared with a non-cardholder's same itinerary. An entire outbound or inbound origin–destination journey must be operated by Air Canada/Rouge/Express. Log in and book through Air Canada; mixed-operated journeys may not qualify. Taxes/cash charges are not reduced.

benefits.title: Fourth night free on Aeroplan hotel redemptions
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: each four consecutive hotel nights in one eligible Aeroplan hotel-portal booking paid entirely with points receive a reduction equal to the average points cost of one night. Cash/points bookings and combined separate reservations do not qualify; local/resort fees may remain payable.

benefits.title: Fourth day free on Aeroplan car rental redemptions
benefits.detail: From January 12, 2027: each four consecutive rental days in one eligible Aeroplan car-portal booking paid entirely with points receive a reduction equal to one day's average points cost. Same vehicle/provider/reservation required; cash/points bookings excluded. Fuel, insurance and local fees may remain payable.

benefits.title: Air Canada AC Wallet flight credit
benefits.detail: From January 15, 2027: basic Cardmember receives C$25 in AC Wallet January 15 and July 15, each expiring after six months. Aeroplan account must be linked at least 72 hours before issue. Use on a new direct Air Canada/Rouge/Express marketed-and-operated cash booking before expiry; not reward-ticket taxes, existing reservations or cash. Account closure cancels unused coupons.

benefits.title: Free first checked bag
benefits.detail: First checked bag up to 23kg/50lb for the eligible Cardmember and up to eight companions on the same reservation when checking in with Air Canada for an Air Canada/Rouge/Express-operated flight. Include the linked Aeroplan number; not extra baggage allowance on an already included bag. Supplementary eligibility follows the card tier.

benefits.title: Flight delay insurance
benefits.detail: Covered missed connection, departure delay or denied boarding with no alternative for four hours: necessary living/sundry expenses. C$500 aggregate per occurrence shared with baggage-delay cover. Full airline fare must be charged to the card.

benefits.title: Delayed & lost baggage insurance
benefits.detail: Delay of checked baggage at the outbound destination for six hours: essentials, sharing C$500 with flight delay. Lost/stolen baggage has a separate C$500 aggregate occurrence limit, including C$300 jewellery/C$250 golf-club sublimits. Full fare payment required. Delay essentials must be purchased within four days and before baggage return.

benefits.title: Hotel/motel burglary insurance
benefits.detail: Up to C$500 per burglary occurrence for covered property loss/damage from accommodation-room burglary. Full accommodation cost must be charged to the card; forcible-entry evidence and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Rental car collision/loss damage insurance
benefits.detail: Primary covered theft/damage on eligible rentals no longer than 48 consecutive days, vehicle MSRP up to C$85,000 before taxes. Charge full rental and decline CDW/LDW where possible. No liability cover; vehicle, territory and rental exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Travel accident insurance
benefits.detail: Scheduled accidental death/dismemberment benefits up to C$500,000 per covered person on a covered common-carrier trip. Charge the fare to the card before injury; eligible spouse/dependent children under 23 are included. Loss must occur within 100 days of the accident; exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible new items paid in full with the card: 90-day accidental physical damage/theft protection, C$1,000/Cardmember/occurrence. Excess of other insurance; exclusions and claims-document requirements apply.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Eligible manufacturer warranties of five years or less extended by up to one year. Full card payment required; C$10,000/item and C$25,000/Cardmember/policy-year limits. Warranty-territory conditions and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Amex Offers
benefits.detail: Register for eligible targeted offers before spending; merchants, thresholds, expiry dates and reward types vary by account.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences and ticket access
benefits.detail: Access eligible Front Of The Line presale and reserved tickets, events and experiences; availability, payment and ticket terms apply.

benefits.title: Fraud protection and emergency card replacement
benefits.detail: Fraud protection requires reasonable care of account details and PIN and prompt notification of suspected misuse. Contact Amex for lost/stolen-card assistance and replacement.

benefits.title: Travel emergency assistance
benefits.detail: 24/7 out-of-town medical/legal referral and coordination services. This is not medical insurance; third-party expenses are your responsibility and services must be arranged/authorized by the assistance provider.

benefits.title: Link Aeroplan and keep points active
benefits.detail: Link your own Aeroplan number to the card and include it on eligible bookings. Airline benefits may take 72 hours to activate. Aeroplan points do not expire while you remain the eligible basic Cardmember and your Aeroplan account is in good standing.

benefits.title: Additional World of Hyatt points
benefits.detail: Link eligible Aeroplan and World of Hyatt accounts before purchase: one World of Hyatt bonus point/C$1 on eligible direct Hyatt purchases, separate from Aeroplan earnings. Basic Cardmember only; no retroactive points. Current linked-program terms run through June 30, 2029; accounts must be in good standing.

benefits.title: Avis Preferred Plus status
benefits.detail: Enroll through the Aeroplan Avis form with an existing Avis account. Upgrade requires approval and follows current Avis status/rental terms; card eligibility and account good standing required.

benefits.title: Status Qualifying Credits from spending
benefits.detail: Earn 1,000 SQC per C$20,000 eligible net purchases posted to the account. Combined maximum 25,000 SQC/member/calendar year across all Aeroplan credit cards/issuers. Additional-card spend counts for the basic Cardmember; SQC are not redeemable points or automatic elite status.

statuses.condition: Basic Cardmember must register through Aeroplan with an existing Avis account; subject to approval and Avis terms. Maintain eligible card and account.

benefits.title: Global Dining Access by Resy
benefits.detail: Add the Reserve Card to your Resy profile for eligible exclusive reservations, Priority Notify and dining experiences. Availability and event charges apply; this is access, separate from the monthly Resy statement credit.

benefits.title: Amex Offers
benefits.detail: Add eligible targeted offers to this card before purchase. Participating merchants, spend thresholds, rewards and expiration vary; offers are not guaranteed recurring credits.

benefits.title: Employee and expense management
benefits.detail: Employee cards, spending controls, alerts, account-manager access and year-end summaries support expense management. Eligible QuickBooks integration requires enrollment; account/card and third-party software charges may apply.

benefits.title: Vendor Pay by BILL
benefits.detail: Enroll for eligible invoice/payment and accounting tools. User count, service plans, payment methods and integrations can incur charges; current Vendor Pay terms apply.

benefits.title: Annual companion certificate
benefits.detail: One companion certificate after each card renewal for eligible Delta First, Delta Comfort or Delta Main paid round-trip itineraries originating in the U.S./Puerto Rico/USVI to covered U.S., Mexico, Caribbean/Central America destinations. Taxes/fees US$22–US$250 on up to four segments; fare-class/inventory rules and same-flight booking apply. Book and fly before expiry, normally one year. Delta Basic excluded; card/eCredit payment terms apply.

benefits.title: MQD Headstart
benefits.detail: Basic Cardmember receives 2,500 MQDs per qualifying product/qualification year; eligible Platinum, Platinum Business, Reserve and Reserve Business are distinct products, maximum four product Headstarts. Deposit normally 6–8 weeks after February 1 or new-card opening. Additional holders receive no Headstart; MQDs are qualification credit, not redeemable miles or an automatic Medallion tier.

benefits.title: MQD Boost
benefits.detail: Earn one MQD per US$10 eligible net purchases/calendar year, including additional-card spend, toward the basic member's qualification. Fees, interest, cash equivalents and returns excluded. No Medallion tier is automatically granted by holding this card.

benefits.title: 15 Sky Club visits; unlimited at US$75,000
benefits.detail: Eligible basic/paid Reserve additional cards receive 15 visits each Medallion year (February 1–January 31). One visit spans up to 24 hours across eligible clubs; same-day Delta-marketed/operated travel required, Basic fares excluded. US$75,000 eligible calendar-year spend unlocks unlimited access for the rest of that calendar year, the following year and through January 31 after that. Further visits generally US$50.

benefits.title: Centurion Lounge access
benefits.detail: Eligible basic/paid Reserve additional Cardmembers: participating Centurion/Sidecar lounges on same-day Delta-marketed/operated travel purchased with an eligible U.S. Amex card. Centurion entry within three hours of departure/five hours of connection; Sidecar within 90 minutes. Up to two same-flight guests, each US$50 (ages 2–17 US$30) at each location; capacity/entry rules apply.

benefits.title: TakeOff 15
benefits.detail: Log into the basic Cardmember's linked SkyMiles account and redeem miles for eligible Delta-operated award travel through delta.com/Fly Delta. 15% discount applies to miles only, not taxes/fees, partner-operated flights or Pay with Miles. Eligible card/account must remain open; current program rules apply.

benefits.title: First bag free; basic member's domestic second bag
benefits.detail: First standard checked bag: eligible basic Cardmember plus up to eight companions on the same reservation. Domestic second standard bag: only travelers who individually hold an eligible basic Delta Amex card, not ordinary companions/additional cardholders. Include each eligible SkyMiles number; Delta-marketed/operated eligible segments and Delta check-in required. No extra allowance above existing free bags; oversize/overweight fees remain.

benefits.title: Zone 5 priority boarding
benefits.detail: Zone 5 boarding for eligible basic Cardmember and up to eight passengers on the same Delta/Delta Connection reservation with the linked SkyMiles number. Boarding follows current fare, itinerary and Delta program rules.

benefits.title: Upgrade priority & complimentary upgrades
benefits.detail: Reserve can give upgrade priority over otherwise comparable Medallion members at the same tier, product/fare experience and Million Miler milestone. Eligible non-Medallion Reserve holders join after Medallions. Qualifying tickets, availability and Delta upgrade rules apply; no guaranteed upgrade or automatic Medallion status.

benefits.title: 20% in-flight savings
benefits.detail: 20% back as a statement credit for eligible Delta-operated pre-purchased meals and in-flight food/beverage purchases paid with the card. Wi-Fi, airfare and other excluded purchases do not qualify; merchant coding and posting rules apply.

benefits.title: 1.5 miles on everything at $150,000
benefits.detail: After US$150,000 eligible net purchases/calendar year, subsequent eligible purchases earn 1.5X through December 31; higher-rate categories keep their higher rate and do not stack. Additional-card spend counts. Build 3 does not automatically apply this account-spend-dependent base-rate change.

benefits.title: Escape Lounge access
benefits.detail: Eligible Reserve basic/paid additional cardholders can access participating Escape Lounges on qualifying same-day Delta-marketed/operated travel booked with an eligible U.S. Amex card. Present card, boarding pass and ID; up to two guests at each lounge's prevailing guest fee. This is not unlimited free guest access.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.detail: American Express charges no foreign transaction fee on purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Premium Global Assist hotline
benefits.detail: 24/7 emergency coordination more than 100 miles from home, including medical/legal referrals, cash wires, prescription replacement and missing-luggage help. Emergency medical transport may be provided at no cost only when approved and arranged by Premium Global Assist. Other third-party expenses may be yours; this is not general medical insurance.

benefits.title: Amex Experiences and ticket access
benefits.detail: Access eligible presale and reserved tickets and participating-event benefits; ticket availability, purchase limits, payment requirements and fees apply.

benefits.title: Pay with Miles
benefits.detail: Redeem eligible SkyMiles in 5,000-mile increments for up to US$50 off qualifying Delta flight purchases on delta.com. Linked basic-card account, itinerary and program terms apply; this is a redemption option, not an additional statement credit.

benefits.title: 3X on eligible direct Delta purchases
benefits.detail: Earn 3 SkyMiles/US$1 on eligible purchases charged directly by Delta as merchant, including qualifying Delta airfare and other issuer-defined direct Delta charges. Third-party airline-ticket merchants do not qualify. The Delta-only rate is described here and is not applied to unrelated airlines in Best Card.

benefits.title: Four Sky Club guest passes
benefits.detail: Basic Reserve Cardmember receives four one-time guest passes per Medallion year; maximum two redeemed per visit. Basic member must accompany guests and enter using Reserve; eligible same-day flights and Basic-fare exclusions apply. Other guests generally US$50; child/house rules apply.

benefits.title: Account tools and dispute assistance
benefits.detail: Use eligible digital-card/app functions, alerts and year-end statements to manage the account. Contact Amex for suspected fraudulent/incorrect charges or lost-card assistance; identity checks, account eligibility and cardmember terms apply.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation & interruption insurance
benefits.detail: Covered round-trip cancellation/interruption: up to US$10,000/trip and US$20,000/card/12 months for each coverage, excess of other benefits. Full common-carrier transport paid with card/allowed points or vouchers; only defined causes qualify, not any reason. Pre-existing conditions and supplier insolvency excluded. Notify insurer and supplier within required times; insurer notice 60 days, proof 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Trip delay reimbursement
benefits.detail: Covered round trip delayed more than 6 hours: up to US$500/trip, two claims/card/12 months, excess of other benefits. Pay full common-carrier transport with the card/allowed points or vouchers and additional expenses with that card. Weather, equipment failure, hijacking/terrorism or lost travel documents may qualify; known delays excluded. Notify within 60 days; proof within 180 days, subject to stated exceptions.

benefits.title: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.detail: Lost/damaged/stolen carry-on: up to US$1,250/person/trip; checked: US$500. High-risk items share a US$250/person sublimit; NY US$10,000/trip aggregate. Full common-carrier fare paid with card/eligible Amex rewards required; other loyalty-program redemptions do not qualify. Excess of other cover; eligible family covered. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Cell phone protection
benefits.detail: Prior month's eligible wireless bill paid with card: covered theft/damage including cracked screens, up to US$800/claim after US$50 deductible, two claims/account/12 months; excess of other insurance. Lost/mysteriously disappeared phones and cosmetic damage excluded. Theft police report within 48 hours; notify claim within 90 days/as soon as reasonably possible, written proof within 120 days.

benefits.title: Purchase protection
benefits.detail: Eligible card-paid new purchases: 90 days against theft/accidental damage/loss; up to US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Natural-disaster sublimit US$500/event. Only eligible card payment is covered; item/event exclusions apply. Notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible; proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.detail: Extends eligible original manufacturer warranties of five years or less by up to one year, after the original warranty/service contract. Warranty must be valid in the US/DC/territories; up to eligible card payment, US$10,000/item and US$50,000/account/calendar year. Exclusions apply; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible and normally submit proof within 60 days.

benefits.title: Car rental loss & damage insurance
benefits.detail: Secondary theft/damage cover up to US$75,000/rental agreement, first 30 consecutive days. Reserve/pay the entire rental with the eligible card and decline CDW/similar cover. Australia, Italy, New Zealand, peer-to-peer rentals and excluded vehicles are not covered; no liability insurance. State provisions vary; notify within 30 days/as soon as reasonably possible, proof normally within 60 days.

benefits.title: Rental-car accident protection
benefits.detail: Eligible covered rental accidents: scheduled accidental death/dismemberment up to US$200,000/Cardmember or US$20,000/other eligible driver/passenger; accidental-injury treatment up to US$5,000/person. Shared US$300,000/accident aggregate. Only for eligible card-paid rentals, not general travel medical insurance. State provisions, authorization, timing and exclusions apply.

benefits.title: Rental-car personal property
benefits.detail: Eligible personal-property theft/damage during a covered rental: up to US$1,000/eligible person and US$2,000/rental accident aggregate. Full eligible rental payment and driver/rental conditions required. Excess coverage, exclusions and state-specific provisions apply.

benefits.title: Return protection
benefits.detail: Eligible items paid entirely with the card in the US/covered territories: if the seller refuses a return within 90 days, up to US$300/item and US$1,000/account/calendar year, excluding original shipping. Item must be unused, undamaged and working; exclusions include jewellery, software and consumables. Notify within 90 days of purchase; requested documents and returned item normally within 30 days of the respective request.

french.Enrol in Hertz Gold Plus Rewards for a o: Inscrivez-vous à Hertz Gold Plus Rewards pour un surclassement d'une catégorie selon la disponibilité sur les locations de 5 jours consécutifs ou plus, et aucuns frais pour un conducteur additionnel.

Aucune assurance frais médicaux d’urgence, annulation ou interruption générale de voyage, ou appareils mobiles n’est indiquée. Résidence canadienne, compte admissible et paiement intégral requis. Signaler les sinistres de location et d’achats dans les 48 heures; garantie : 45 jours; accident : avis écrit dans les 30 jours ou dès que raisonnablement possible. Autres sinistres de voyage : agir rapidement, avec avis écrit sous 90 jours lorsque possible. Exclusions et justificatifs du certificat applicables.
french.Delay of checked baggage at the outbound: Retard des bagages enregistrés d’au moins six heures à destination à l’aller : articles essentiels, plafond de 500 $ CA partagé avec le retard de vol. Perte ou vol : plafond distinct de 500 $ CA par événement, dont 300 $ pour les bijoux et 250 $ pour les bâtons de golf. Billet payé intégralement. Achats liés au retard effectués dans les quatre jours et avant la restitution des bagages.
french.Scheduled accidental death/dismemberment: Prestations prévues jusqu’à 500 000 $ CA par assuré en cas de décès ou de mutilation accidentels pendant un voyage couvert en transport public. Billet porté à la carte avant la blessure; conjoint et enfants à charge admissibles de moins de 23 ans inclus. Perte dans les 100 jours de l’accident; exclusions applicables.
french.Automatic Hilton Honors Gold for the bas: Statut Hilton Honors Gold automatique pour le titulaire principal; délai maximal de 12 semaines après l’ouverture du compte. Prend fin à l’annulation de la carte; compte en règle requis. Avantages hôteliers variables selon la marque et la disponibilité.
french.Up to nine supplementary cards with no a: Jusqu’à neuf cartes supplémentaires sans frais annuels pour les personnes de 13 ans et plus. Leurs achats admissibles rapportent des points et comptent pour les avantages annuels du titulaire principal.
french.Earn 50,000 bonus Hilton Honors points o: Une prime de 50 000 points Hilton Honors par année civile après l’inscription de 12 000 $ CA d’achats nets admissibles au plus tard le 31 décembre. Achats des cartes supplémentaires inclus; prime au titulaire principal au premier cycle de facturation suivant le mois admissible. Aucun report.
french.New applicants October 29, 2026–January: Nouveaux demandeurs du 29 octobre 2026 au 11 janvier 2027 : 60 000 points et une nuit gratuite après 3 000 $ CA d’achats nets inscrits en trois mois; 10 000 points de plus après 500 $ CA au 13e mois. Titulaires actuels et anciens exclus. Chambre standard sous réserve de disponibilité et d’hôtels exclus, réservée par téléphone; récompense émise sous 16 semaines et valide 12 mois. Conditions du compte applicables.
french.24/7 out-of-town emergency medical/legal: Services de coordination et d’orientation médicale ou juridique d’urgence hors domicile, 24 heures sur 24. L’assistance ne paie pas elle-même les soins ou autres frais de tiers; communiquer avec le fournisseur pour les dispositions autorisées.
french.Gold members can receive a fifth night f: Les membres Gold peuvent obtenir la cinquième nuit gratuite lors de séjours-récompenses admissibles en chambre standard payés entièrement en points. Aucun frais de villégiature pour les séjours payés entièrement en points; modalités de l’hôtel et du programme applicables. Avantage du programme Hilton, sans certificat annuel de nuit gratuite.
french.Register for eligible targeted offers be: S’inscrire aux offres ciblées admissibles avant de dépenser. Commerçants, seuils, récompenses et dates d’expiration varient selon l’offre et le compte.
french.Front Of The Line presale and reserved-t: Accès aux préventes et billets réservés Avant-première pour les événements participants. Paiement intégral Amex, disponibilité, frais de billetterie et restrictions applicables.
french.Contact Amex promptly for lost/stolen ca: Aviser rapidement Amex en cas de carte perdue ou volée ou d’utilisation suspecte. La protection contre la fraude exige des précautions raisonnables pour le compte et le NIP; services de remplacement et modalités du compte applicables.
french.Business payment and employee controls: Options de paiement et gestion des employés

Autres assurances : résidence canadienne, compte admissible et paiement intégral requis. Location et achats : déclaration sous 48 heures; garantie : 45 jours; autres délais selon le certificat.
french.Register in Amex Offers: up to C$50 Janu: S’inscrire aux Offres Amex : jusqu’à 50 $ CA de janvier à juin et 50 $ de juillet à décembre pour les achats admissibles en dollars canadiens chez Dell Canada en ligne, livrés au Canada, jusqu’au 31 décembre 2026. Carte principale inscrite seulement; cartes-cadeaux, produits remis à neuf, Dell Financial Services et portails exclus selon les modalités. Crédit sous 90 jours après chaque semestre.
french.Register before spending: C$10 monthly c: S’inscrire avant l’achat : crédit mensuel de 10 $ CA pour une transaction Instacart Canada admissible d’au moins 10 $ CA jusqu’au 31 décembre 2027. Livraison au Canada et carte principale inscrite requises; cartes-cadeaux, médicaments sur ordonnance et alcool exclus. Aucun report.
french.Register before spending: up to C$50 per: S’inscrire avant l’achat : jusqu’à 50 $ CA par trimestre civil, 200 $ au total en 2026, pour les achats admissibles en dollars canadiens directement sur ca.indeed.com jusqu’au 31 décembre 2026. Carte principale inscrite seulement; Indeed Events, Hire, Flex, services aux chercheurs d’emploi et sociétés affiliées exclus selon les modalités. Crédit sous 90 jours après le trimestre.
french.Register and spend C$50 cumulatively or: S’inscrire et dépenser 50 $ CA en une ou plusieurs transactions directement sur quickbooks.ca/amex au plus tard le 28 février 2027 pour un crédit unique de 50 $ CA. Site canadien, dollars canadiens et carte principale inscrite requis. Revendeurs, matériel, tSheets, TurboTax, CreditKarma, MailChimp et Quicken exclus; renouvellements d’abonnement possibles. Crédit sous 90 jours après la fin de l’offre.
french.Earn 10,000 Membership Rewards points af: Prime de 10 000 points-privilèges après 20 000 $ CA d’achats nets admissibles par trimestre civil, jusqu’à 40 000 points-primes par an. Achats des cartes supplémentaires inclus; compteur remis à zéro chaque trimestre sans report. Prime en plus du taux de 1 point par dollar admissible.
french.Enroll in Hertz Gold Plus Rewards with C: S’inscrire à Hertz Gold Plus Rewards avec le CDP 705500 et réserver directement chez Hertz, en payant avec une carte admissible. Surclassement d’une catégorie pour les locations d’au moins cinq jours, frais d’un conducteur additionnel supprimés et rabais applicables, sous réserve des restrictions de lieu, véhicule, disponibilité et dates. Aucun statut Hertz Five Star attribué.
french.Book at least two consecutive nights at: Réserver au moins deux nuits consécutives dans un établissement participant par un canal Amex Voyages admissible et payer intégralement avec une carte admissible. Jusqu’à 100 $ US de services admissibles portés à la chambre et surclassement d’une catégorie selon disponibilité. Tarif de chambre, taxes et pourboires exclus; aucun remboursement en espèces ni report.
french.No preset spending limit does not mean u: L’absence de limite préétablie ne signifie pas un crédit illimité. Limites de cartes supplémentaires, rapports de dépenses, relevés et alertes facilitent la gestion.

french.After the first card anniversary and eac: Après le premier anniversaire et chaque renouvellement, une nuit gratuite en chambre standard d’au plus 35 000 points, normalement 8 à 10 semaines après la date annuelle du compte.
